messages.subject: Project Vertex - Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Good to be working with you again. Please find our first cut of the Heads of Terms for the CBX-417 licence and the assignment of the two improvement families. Key points: exclusive worldwide licence in oncology, £6m upfront, tiered royalties 6/9/12%, and outright assignment of CBX-VTX-013 and 014. The exclusivity and governing-law paragraphs are intended to bind.

Grateful for Calbryn's comments this week.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Vertex - Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks. Calbryn is broadly comfortable. Two points at HoT stage: (1) they'd like the upfront nearer £7.5m given the granted composition-of-matter position; and (2) they want to retain the ability to license outside oncology. We can live with the exclusivity period to 30 September. I'll send a marked HoT tomorrow but content to proceed to the full licence draft in parallel.

Rachel Hargrove
Partner, Hargrove & Associates LLP
